panels.title: RGB + sample paths
panels.description: Scene color. Colored polylines = top-ranked legacy routes (polyline_2d). Green = geodesic when present.

panels.title: path_cost_map (legacy A*)
components: RGB Sobel edges (strong edges cost more)
Gaussian-smoothed union of object masks (obstacle cost)
1 - distance-to-free-space from obstacles (centering / open corridor bias)

panels.title: path_traversability_speed (geodesic)
panels.bright_means: higher speed (easier motion; geodesic prefers these pixels)
components: Feasible = (region label > 0) AND NOT obstacle mask; elsewhere low speed floor
Depth-gradient flatness: exp(-|grad z| / scale) when metric depth is available
Mild RGB edge penalty: 1 - w_edge * normalized Sobel magnitude

reading_tip: Compare cost vs speed: texture can dominate cost, while depth jumps dominate speed.
